feature_selection.definition: Select dynamically expressed molecular features that best preserve continuous cellular trajectories.
feature_selection.details: Used Spearman correlation and mutual information with `annotated_age` (pseudotime) to rank and select features.

trajectory_preservation.definition: Preserve continuous cellular trajectories while reducing confounding variation.
trajectory_preservation.details: Evaluated using UMAP visualizations and Silhouette scores for phase (biological progression) and batch (confounder).
